svg.title: A depth-four stationary portrait, with every cell retained
svg.desc: Exact square-normalized depth-four approximation for the repeated address (0,1). Its 65536 cells lie in a 9216 by 9216 grid and occupy area fraction 1/1296. This is one finite piece, not a complete target or an image of all quantum coefficients.

g.text: (i,j) = (0,1) at every level · 65,536 occupied cells · exact vector detail
Zoom this figure to inspect the small cells. The pale area belongs to the target, not to this piece.
